chapters.title: The One Percent Solution
chapters.goal: Introduce the protagonist to the System and reveal the broken 'Crit' multiplier during a fatal tutorial encounter.
chapters.stakes_shift: From certain death as a mundane human to survival as a glitched outlier with a lethal damage ceiling.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in the real world and awakens in the tutorial zone.
bridge.to_next: Armed with a broken mechanic, the protagonist seeks to maximize tutorial rewards before the zone closes.

sections.title: The Fatal Error
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's mundane death and the jarring transition into the System tutorial.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.

scenes.summary: Artie dies in a hospital bed and experiences a surreal transition into a digital void.
scenes.outcome: Artie is transported to the tutorial zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie’s consciousness slips away as the hospital room monitor emits a long, flat tone.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie’s eyes snap open to find himself standing in a featureless white expanse.

scenes.summary: Artie explores the white void and interacts with the first System prompt.
scenes.outcome: Artie accepts the tutorial and gains his first status window.
scenes.transition_in_text: The humming of the white expanse intensifies as a blue window flickers into existence.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie reaches out to touch the floating prompt, and the world shifts around him.

sections.title: Identifying the Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce the combat mechanics and the first realization that the Crit multiplier is behaving abnormally.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.

scenes.summary: Artie approaches a training dummy and attempts basic combat maneuvers.
scenes.outcome: Artie learns the basics of the combat system.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white void resolves into a structured training arena containing a single straw dummy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie grips the wooden sword, feeling the strange weight of a digital weapon.

scenes.summary: Artie strikes the dummy multiple times, noticing a strange variance in damage numbers.
scenes.outcome: Artie identifies a pattern in his critical hits.
scenes.transition_in_text: The first strike lands with a dull thud, but the damage readout flickers erratically.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie narrows his eyes as a '1.5x' multiplier suddenly jumps to '10x' for no reason.

scenes.summary: Artie focuses on the timing of his strikes and triggers a massive physics-breaking crit.
scenes.outcome: The training dummy is destroyed by a 100x crit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie swings with everything he has, aiming for the exact moment the multiplier glitches.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.
scenes.transition_out_text: The dummy vanishes in a spray of corrupted pixels as the System struggles to calculate the damage.

sections.title: The First Payday
sections.intent: Show the protagonist intentionally using the glitch to secure high-value loot from the first tutorial mob.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the first live-combat zone and encounters a tutorial rat.
scenes.outcome: Artie prepares to test the glitch on a live enemy.
scenes.transition_in_text: A stone corridor manifests around Artie, smelling of damp earth and digital decay.
scenes.transition_out_text: A pair of red eyes glows in the darkness of the corridor ahead.

scenes.summary: Artie engages the tutorial rat, carefully managing his strikes to build the multiplier.
scenes.outcome: Artie successfully stacks the glitch against the rat.
scenes.transition_in_text: The tutorial rat lunges, but Artie sidesteps, waiting for the multiplier to pulse.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie brings the wooden sword down in a perfect arc as the multiplier hits its peak.

scenes.summary: The rat is obliterated by an overkill strike, and Artie loots a legendary item.
scenes.transition_in_text: The rat explodes with the force of a small bomb, leaving behind a shimmering golden chest.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.

chapters.title: Looting the Logic Gates
chapters.goal: Systematically dismantle tutorial challenges to acquire high-tier 'Starter' gear through overkill bonuses.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lucky survivor to a heavily geared exploiter who is now ahead of the intended power curve.

bridge.from_prev: The protagonist realizes the System rewards 'overkill' damage with better loot drops.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist enters the first major hub city and attracts unwanted attention from the local guard.

sections.title: The Overkill Protocol
sections.intent: The protagonist tests the limits of the 'Crit' multiplier to maximize loot drops across multiple encounters.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist confirms that damage exceeding 1000% of enemy HP guarantees a rarity tier jump.

scenes.summary: Artie tests the Legendary Dagger on a group of tutorial slimes.
scenes.outcome: Artie confirms the dagger synergizes with the glitch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps into the Tutorial Field, testing the weight of his new Legendary Dagger.
scenes.transition_out_text: A cluster of blue slimes wobbles toward him, perfect for another round of testing.

scenes.summary: Artie performs precise overkill strikes on the slimes, recording the loot results.
scenes.outcome: Artie notices a correlation between overkill percentage and loot quality.
scenes.transition_in_text: The first slime pops like a water balloon under the dagger's glitched edge.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie opens his log, comparing the damage numbers to the items dropped.

scenes.summary: Artie pushes the multiplier to 1000% on the final slime of the pack.
scenes.outcome: Artie confirms the 1000% overkill threshold for rarity jumps.
scenes.transition_in_text: The last slime expands as Artie charges his strike, the multiplier climbing toward four digits.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist confirms that damage exceeding 1000% of enemy HP guarantees a rarity tier jump.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie pockets the Rare Slime Core and looks toward the looming Boss Room.

sections.title: Boss Room Bypass
sections.intent: A high-intensity fight where the protagonist uses the glitch to one-shot the Tutorial Boss.
sections.end_condition: The Tutorial Boss is vaporized by a single strike, dropping a unique 'Glitched' item.

scenes.summary: Artie approaches the Boss Room and prepares his buffs.
scenes.outcome: Artie is ready for the final tutorial challenge.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air grows heavy with the scent of ozone as Artie stands before the Boss Room door.
scenes.transition_out_text: He consumes a temporary strength potion, his muscles tightening for the coming blow.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the Boss Room and faces the Tutorial Guardian.
scenes.outcome: The fight begins, and Artie dodges the Guardian's initial attacks.
scenes.transition_in_text: The doors slam shut behind Artie as the Tutorial Guardian rises from its throne.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Guardian swings a massive stone club, which Artie narrowly avoids.

scenes.summary: Artie waits for the perfect opening to trigger the glitch.
scenes.outcome: Artie finds the 'logic gap' in the Guardian's defense.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie circles the Guardian, watching the way its digital frame stutters during a heavy swing.
scenes.transition_out_text: He lunges forward, aiming for the glowing core exposed in the Guardian's chest.

scenes.summary: Artie strikes the core with a massive glitched crit.
scenes.outcome: The Boss is destroyed, and Artie gains a glitched item.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Legendary Dagger sinks into the core, and the damage numbers begin to spiral out of control.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Tutorial Boss is vaporized by a single strike, dropping a unique 'Glitched' item.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie picks up the pulsing 'Glitched Fragment' from the pile of boss loot.

sections.title: Graduation Day
sections.intent: The protagonist prepares to leave the tutorial zone with an inventory full of unintended gear.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main game world.

scenes.summary: Artie organizes his inventory and equips his new gear.
scenes.outcome: Artie is fully geared for the main game.
scenes.transition_in_text: The dust settles in the Boss Room as Artie begins sorting through his overflowing inventory.
scenes.transition_out_text: He equips the 'Glitched Plate' and 'Tutorial Master's Boots', feeling his stats skyrocket.

scenes.summary: Artie approaches the exit portal, reflecting on his progress.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he has broken the tutorial's intended balance.
scenes.transition_in_text: A swirling blue vortex opens at the back of the chamber, beckoning him toward the real world.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes a final look at the tutorial zone, a smirk playing on his lips.

scenes.summary: Artie steps into the portal and leaves the tutorial.
scenes.outcome: Artie arrives in the main game hub.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps into the vortex, and the tutorial zone dissolves into a kaleidoscope of light.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main game world.
